verdict.rationale: Framework coverage is a fair axis for a compliance automation platform like Drata, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions ISO 27001, the Annex A control set, a Statement of Applicability, or certification-audit artifacts. The generic framework and audit API endpoints (List Frameworks, Create Custom Framework, List Audits) are building blocks a user could configure. They are not evidence of first-class ISO 27001 support, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a security engineer, ISO 27001 is a first-class framework — the current Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability, and certification-audit artifacts are supported, not just mapped
